tools.name: kokomoji_lookup
tools.description: Free. Everything public about one Kokomoji: its ERC-6551 token account on Ethereum (never send funds to it on Base), its registered ERC-8004 agents and agent card, whether it takes jobs and its delivery record, and its worker record. Optionally its last jobs (type, time, status, settlement transacti

tools.name: kokomoji_agents
tools.description: Free. Every ERC-8004 agent bound to a Kokomoji (from https://kokomoji.art/agent/register/index.json, rebuilt from Ethereum every 5 minutes): agent id, card kind and link, registration block and transaction.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: Free. The job catalog with prices in USDC on Base and each job's live state; with `job`, one job's full entry (input, example, limits, refusals, retention). Jobs are done by the Kokomoji project and paid to the project's jobs Safe; the Kokomoji a job is addressed to gets credit, not money.

tools.name: job_check
tools.description: Free. Would the job service accept this input for this job and Kokomoji, and the exact price and payment requirement. Nothing is charged and no job starts.

tools.description: Paid (x402 v2, USDC on Base, only to the Kokomoji jobs Safe 0xb2492145ea92947C0b8dF138a398fcB22782a575; charged only when the result is delivered). tools.name: job_result
tools.description: Free. A delivered job result, by its job id (32 hex) or by the X-Job-Key it was paid with.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: Free. Tasks on the Kokomoji open board (private tasks redacted). rewardUsd is what the worker gets; totalUsd is what the poster paid.

tools.name: board_task
tools.description: Free. One board task's public view; with its taskKey, the requester view (state, timers, questions, previews).

tools.name: board_post
tools.description: Paid. Posts a task in plain words. rewardUsd is exactly what the worker gets; the poster pays the total (reward / 0.75, or / 0.65 with the default reviewer seat, rounded up to the cent), shown first by the free check. tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Free. Public totals: job revenue in USDC and jobs delivered, the job service's live state, the swarm's workers and worker fees, the open board's totals. Totals and counts only, the dashboard's sources.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Free. Searches the Kokomoji docs, the agent manual and llms.txt by words and returns the best sections with links.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "kokomoji_lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: board_post · Private data: kokomoji_lookup, job_run, board_list · Public sink: kokomoji_lookup, board_post · Destructive: job_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: board_post · Private data: kokomoji_lookup, job_run, board_list · Public sink: kokomoji_lookup, board_post · Destructive: job_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: board_post, agent_join_check · Private data: kokomoji_lookup, job_run, board_list, agent_join_check · Public sink: kokomoji_lookup, board_post, agent_join_check · Destructive: job_run

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "job_run" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
